Subject: Financial steward check-in: procurement path & security onboarding

Hi Claire / Michael —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

Call recap (2 min):
- Primary use case: AtriWave wants to embed real-time summarization into provider notes to cut charting time by ~40%.
- Target scope: pilot with 3 clinics (~120 active users), 30k tokens/day estimated.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in clinician charting time + no PHI leakage, <300ms median token latency.

Open asks / next steps:
1) Economic/budget owner — who signs the PO for pilots?
2) Procurement & legal intake — who manages vendor onboarding and security questionnaires (SOC2, DPIA)?
3) Timeline — what month would procurement want the pilot to start?
4) We attached a 1-page MAP and our security brief; please confirm any additional evidence you need.

Attachments: MAP-draft-AtriWave.xlsx (draft mutual action plan), redwood-security-brief-v2.pdf (SOC2 summary, data handling).

Proposed immediate step: 30-min intro with the budget owner + procurement/legal (if possible this or next week). Do any of these slots work for Michael and the legal owner?
- Tue 10/24 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 10/25 14:00–14:30 PT

If procurement needs a checklist up front, I can send our bite-sized vendor intake packet (one page) so your team can triage quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

Best,

Thanks for the clear recap, Jonas — good call. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Budget owner: Michael Patel (CFO) will ultimately sign off on pilot spend. Michael is CC'd here. He owns the pilot budget for Q4.
2) Procurement / legal: Our LegalOps lead, Sandeep Rao (sandeep.rao@atriwave.com), owns vendor intake and security questionnaires — I’ll loop him into the next thread.
3) Timeline: we are aiming to kick pilots in early December (pilot work and clinical approvals need ~6 weeks). Procurement prefers completed intake + PO 2–3 weeks before start.

We reviewed the MAP and security brief attached — looks good at a high level. Sandeep will want a completed vendor security questionnaire and a brief on data residency. He also asked whether Redwood can sign our standard BAAs and provide a DPIA excerpt.

Availability: I can do a three-way intro call next week on 10/24 between 10–11am PT — Michael is available 10/24 10:15–10:45 PT; Sandeep can join for the intake discussion. If that works, can you send a calendar invite and a short agenda?

Thanks — Claire
